meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 把 Linear 频道接入 Claude:它监控你指定的一个 Linear 团队,该团队任意 issue 下出现评论就自动回复,不需要 @ 提及,每个 issue 的评论线程是独立会话。
howto.when: 当被监控的 Linear 团队里任意 issue 新增评论时触发,无需 @ 提及;也可在按提示安装、配置该频道时进入这套步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 频道接进来,团队 key 是 ENG
say.note: Claude 会走复制适配器、装依赖、写 .env 等步骤

say.text: 这个 Linear 工作区是公开的,发送者策略用 strict
say.note: 公开工作区下只允许已注册成员与它对话

say.text: 我不用 OAuth 应用,改用 Personal API Key

howto.what_en: Adds Linear as a channel: the agent watches one Linear team, and every comment on that team's issues triggers a reply — no @-mention needed. Each issue's comment thread becomes its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new comment appears on any issue of the watched Linear team; no @-mention is needed, since Linear OAuth apps cannot be mentioned.

say_en.text: Add the Linear channel for me; the team key is ENG
say_en.note: Claude copies the adapter, installs the dep, and writes .env

say_en.text: This Linear workspace is public, use the strict sender policy
say_en.note: On a public workspace, only registered members may talk to it

say_en.text: Skip the OAuth app, use a Personal API Key instead
say_en.note: Answer none at the OAuth prompts and set LINEAR_API_KEY
